structured_output.what_is_happening: "affective autism" (a/aut) is one of at least 11 tokens with the same name launched within about 15 minutes. This one clearly leads the cluster: $180k market cap against $31k liquidity, while the rest are dead or below $55k. About 30 minutes after launch it has pulled in roughly 1,279 unique buyers against 113 sellers, about $185k of volume, and a +112–243% move. Its links are recycled: an old Elon Musk tweet (status 1680821019152379904, from 2023) and a PubMed paper (38923977) whose page returned a captcha when I fetched it. I found no web-indexed catalyst, X post or discussion about a/aut or the contract.

narrative.description: An autism meme riffing on an academic 'affective autism' paper, with an Elon link pasted in. The autism meme is an established Solana theme, but I could not find the specific trigger for this name.
narrative.why_spreading: Probably a tweet or call-channel post that isn't visible to search. The burst of same-name launches points to a shared trigger that coin launchers were racing to copy. The flow of money suggests the trench crowd picked this contract as the winner.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has by far the highest market cap, liquidity and buyer count of the same-name tokens, so the market has picked it as the de facto canonical coin.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name a/aut tokens, most at about $3k market cap or with zero liquidity. 56aJJ... has $8k liquidity and 208k h1 volume. E5Y2... had 183k h1 volume and then went to zero liquidity, which suggests fast rugs among the copies.

authenticity.evidence: The buyer base is broad: 1,279 unique buyers against 113 sellers, and a 1,721/572 buy/sell count on DexScreener. GMGN flags 44 bundler wallets, 8 snipers, and an 89-wallet trade insider network. No paid boosts and no smart-money or KOL wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X or Telegram, so I don't know what started this or whether a call channel is driving it.
